title: Templates
intro: Start from a meeting that already works: for a team, a school, a non-profit, a construction site or a care unit. Everything stays editable.
healthNotice: No identifiable patient data in Ronde's cloud: write “Patient A” or initials, never a name. For health data, host Ronde on your own servers.
saveHint: Any meeting can become a workspace template: open its settings, then “Save as a template”.
